newsitem.title: USA: Dolan leaves Pru for Lebenthal Asset Management.
newsitem.headline: Dolan leaves Pru for Lebenthal Asset Management.

text.p: Lebenthal Asset Management Inc said Monday that Patricia Dolan joined the firm as senior managing director.
Dolan joins Lebenthal from Prudential Investment Advisors, where she managed about $1.7 billion in mutual funds.
At Lebenthal, Dolan will be in charge of strategic planning, client relations, marketing and new business.
Lebenthal Asset Management is the portfolio management subsidiary of Lebenthal & Co, the retail bond firm. It manages three mutual funds with total assets of $141.2 million.

"Dealing with a force in bonds like Pat will be a joy and boon for our high net worth clients, present and prospective," James Gammon, Lebenthal Asset Management's president and senior portfolio manager, said.
